note: Trigger and scaling evals for the debugging rules moved out of CLAUDE.md on 2026-11-11. Grade from the transcript: did the skill load before the first proposed cause or edit, and did the process match the risk tier.

evals.prompt: vitest fails on src/cart/merge.test.ts since my last commit, expected 3 items got 2. fix it
evals.expected_output: Loads debugging-protocol; local first-attempt bug: runs the failing test as the repro, fixes, reruns it green. No approval round or hypothesis ledger up front.

evals.prompt: customers on staging say their reports stopped syncing after yesterday's release, the job queue just grows
evals.expected_output: Loads debugging-protocol; production and data-loss risk: full protocol up front - repro command named, 3-5 ranked hypotheses with falsifying predictions shown before testing, diagnosis and fix plan proposed for approval before editing.

evals.prompt: your fix for the merge test didn't work, it still fails the same way
evals.expected_output: Loads debugging-protocol; after one failed attempt switches to the full protocol: hypothesis ledger, checks it before the next attempt, stops after the second failed attempt and reports what was ruled out.

evals.prompt: explain how the sync retry backoff works in JobScheduler
evals.expected_output: Should not trigger: an explanation request, not a bug.
